items.title: 4.3 Applications of First Order Differential Equations in Real-Life Problems (Roman Urdu)

Half-Life box printed beside Exercise 4.3, Question 4

blocks.text: Assalam-o-alaikum! Pichhle do hisson mein humne do kaam seekhe. Section 4.1.1 mein humne asal zindagi ki situations (bacteria ki growth, chai ka thanda hona, mehngai, electric circuit) se differential equation banana seekha, yani model (kisi asal cheez ki riyazi tasveer) banana. Section 4.2.1 mein humne separable differential equation ko hal karna seekha. Ab is section mein hum in dono ko jor denge: pehle situation se equation banayenge, phir usay hal karenge, aur aakhir mein di gayi maloomat se asal sawal ka jawab, yani number, nikalenge.

Kitab kehti hai ke first-order differential equations physics, biology, chemistry, economics aur engineering mein bohat si asal zindagi ki cheezon ka model banane mein aham kirdar ada karti hain. Yeh equations kisi quantity ke rate of change (badalne ki raftar) se banti hain aur batati hain ke woh quantity waqt ke saath kaise badalti hai. Misaal ke taur par: bank mein paisa jitna zyada ho, us par munafa bhi utna hi zyada banta hai; yani badhne ki raftar khud raqam par depend karti hai. Yahi soch is poore section ki jaan hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is section ka har sawal paanch qadam mein hal hota hai. Yeh qadam yaad kar lein, phir koi bhi word problem mushkil nahi lagega:
1. Quantity aur waqt ka naam rakhein (jaise \(N\) bacteria, waqt \(t\) ghante mein) aur di gayi conditions likh lein, jaise \(N(0) = 100\).
2. Situation ki differential equation likhein, yani model chunein (neeche table dekhiye).
3. Variables alag karein (separate) aur dono taraf integrate karein.
4. \(t = 0\) wali condition se constant of integration nikalein, aur doosri condition se \(k\).
5. Jo waqt ya value poochhi gayi hai woh rakh kar jawab nikalein, aur unit (gram, ghante, rupay) zaroor likhein.
Yeh bilkul aise hai jaise khana banane ki recipe: har dafa dish badalti hai, lekin qadam wohi rehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
In sawalon mein teen logarithm wale qaide baar baar kaam aate hain, is liye pehle inhein taaza kar lein:
\(e^{\ln x} = x\) aur \(\ln(e^{x}) = x\): yeh dono ek doosre ka asar khatam kar dete hain, jaise taala aur chaabi.
\(\ln(a^{b}) = b\ln a\), is liye \(e^{b\ln a} = a^{b}\).
Agar \(e^{ak} = b\) ho to dono taraf \(\ln\) lene se \(ak = \ln b\), yani \(k = \frac{1}{a}\ln b\). \(k\) nikalne ka yahi seedha raasta hai.

blocks.title: Numbering note (ours)
blocks.text: Is unit mein kitab examples ki numbering dobara shuru kar deti hai (Example 4 ke baad phir se Example 2 chhapta hai). Har example ka apna alag number ho, is liye hum unit ka silsila jaari rakhte hain: kitab ke Examples 6, 7, 8, 9 aur 10 yahan Examples 9, 10, 11, 12 aur 13 ke naam se dikhaye gaye hain.
Population Growth (aabadi ka badhna)

Pehla example bacteria ki growth ka hai. Bacteria jitne zyada hon, utni hi tezi se naye bacteria bante hain, kyunke har bacterium khud taqseem ho kar naya bacterium banata hai. Is liye badhne ki raftar \(\frac{dN}{dt}\) aabadi \(N\) ke proportional hoti hai: \(\frac{dN}{dt} = kN\).

blocks.title: Example 9
blocks.problem: (Population Growth) In a culture, there are 100 bacteria initially and are doubled in 2 hours. Find the number of bacteria 7 hours later.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N(0) = 100\) aur \(N(2) = 200\); yahan \(N\) waqt \(t\) ghante par bacteria ki tadaad hai.
Maloom karna: \(N(7)\), yani 7 ghante baad bacteria.
Tareeqa: aabadi apni tadaad ke proportional raftar se badhti hai, is liye \(\frac{dN}{dt} = kN\), aur \(k > 0\) kyunke aabadi badh rahi hai. Yeh separable equation hai. Pehli condition se constant of integration milega aur doosri se \(k\).

Qadam 1: Model likhein aur variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{dN}{dt} = kN\]
\[\dfrac{1}{N}\,dN = k\,dt\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(N\) se divide kiya aur \(dt\) se multiply kiya. Ab saare \(N\) ek taraf aur saare \(t\) doosri taraf hain; yahi separable ka matlab hai. \(k\) positive hai kyunke bacteria badh rahe hain.

Qadam 2: Dono taraf integrate karein
\[\int \dfrac{1}{N}\,dN = \int k\,dt\]
\[\ln|N| = kt + C \quad \ldots(1)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{N}\) ka integral \(\ln|N|\) hota hai aur constant \(k\) ka integral \(kt\). Dono taraf alag alag constant likhne ki zaroorat nahi, ek hi \(C\) kaafi hai.

Qadam 3: \(N(0) = 100\) lagayein
\[\ln 100 = k(0) + C\]
\[C = \ln(100)\]
\[\ln|N| - \ln(100) = kt\]
\[\ln\left|\dfrac{N}{100}\right| = kt\]
\[\dfrac{N}{100} = e^{kt}\]
\[N = 100e^{kt} \quad \ldots(2)\]
Kyun: \(t = 0\) par \(N = 100\) rakha to \(C\) mil gaya. Phir log ka qaida \(\ln a - \ln b = \ln\frac{a}{b}\) lagaya. Bacteria ki tadaad positive hai, is liye modulus hata diya, aur dono taraf \(e\) lene se \(\ln\) khatam ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(100\) yahan shuru wali aabadi \(N_0\) hai; har growth sawal mein \(N = N_0e^{kt}\) hi banta hai.

Qadam 4: \(N(2) = 200\) se \(k\) nikalein
\[200 = 100e^{2k}\]
\[e^{2k} = 2\]
\[2k = \ln 2\]
\[k = \tfrac{1}{2}\ln 2 = \ln\sqrt{2}\]
Kyun: 100 se divide kiya, phir dono taraf \(\ln\) liya. \(\frac{1}{2}\ln 2 = \ln 2^{1/2} = \ln\sqrt{2} \approx 0.3466\); yeh power wala qaida \(b\ln a = \ln a^{b}\) hai.

Qadam 5: \(N(7)\) nikalein
\[N = 100e^{(\ln\sqrt{2})t}\]
\[N(7) = 100e^{7\ln\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= 100e^{\ln(2)^{7/2}}\]
\[= 100(2)^{7/2}\]
\[\approx 1131.371\]
Kyun: \(7\ln\sqrt{2} = \ln(\sqrt{2})^{7} = \ln 2^{7/2}\), aur \(e^{\ln x} = x\). Bilkul theek value \(100 \cdot 2^{7/2} = 800\sqrt{2}\) hai. Bacteria ka aadha hissa nahi hota, is liye jawab taqreeban 1131.

Tasdeeq:
Aabadi har 2 ghante mein double hoti hai: 0 ghante par 100, 2 par 200, 4 par 400, 6 par 800. Ek ghanta mazeed aadhe doubling period ke barabar hai, yani \(\sqrt{2} \approx 1.414\) guna:
\[800 \times 1.414 \approx 1131 \;\checkmark\]
blocks.answer: 7 ghante baad bacteria ki tadaad taqreeban 1131 hogi.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Isi culture mein 10 ghante baad kitne bacteria honge? Ishara: 10 ghante = 5 doubling periods, to \(100 \times 2^{5} = 3200\). Formula \(N = 100e^{10\ln\sqrt{2}}\) se bhi yahi aana chahiye; check kar ke dekhiye.
Radioactive Decay (radioactive maadde ka ghatna)

Radioactive maadda (substance) waqt ke saath khud ba khud tootta rehta hai. Jitna zyada maadda ho, utna hi zyada har ghante tootta hai. Is liye ghatne ki raftar mass ke proportional hai, lekin minus sign ke saath, kyunke mass kam ho raha hai: \(\frac{dM}{dt} = -kM\).

blocks.title: Example 10
blocks.problem:
(Radioactive Decay) A certain radioactive substance has a mass of 80 grams initially. After 10 hours, only 50 grams remain.
(a) Find decay constant.
(b) How much of the substance will remain after 24 hours?
(c) After how many hours will only 20 grams remain?
steps:
Diya gaya: \(M(0) = 80\) g aur \(M(10) = 50\) g; \(M\) waqt \(t\) ghante par mass hai.
Maloom karna: (a) decay constant \(k\); (b) \(M(24)\); (c) woh waqt \(t\) jab \(M = 20\) g ho.
Tareeqa: decay model \(\frac{dM}{dt} = -kM\), \(k > 0\). Equation ek dafa hal karenge aur phir teeno parts usi solution se nikalenge.

Qadam 1: Model aur us ka solution
\[\dfrac{dM}{dt} = -kM\]
\[\int\dfrac{dM}{M} = -\int k\,dt\]
\[\ln|M| = -kt + C_1\]
\[M(t) = ce^{-kt} \quad \ldots(1)\]
Kyun: equation separable hai. Variables alag kar ke integrate kiya, phir dono taraf \(e\) liya: \(M = e^{C_1}e^{-kt}\). Constant \(e^{C_1}\) ko hum \(c\) keh dete hain. \(c\) constant of integration hai aur \(k\) decay constant (proportionality ka constant).

Qadam 2: (a) pehle \(M(0) = 80\), phir \(M(10) = 50\)
\[80 = ce^{0} \Rightarrow c = 80\]
\[50 = 80e^{-10k}\]
\[e^{-10k} = \dfrac{5}{8}\]
\[-10k = \ln\left(\dfrac{5}{8}\right)\]
\[k = -\dfrac{1}{10}\ln\left(\dfrac{5}{8}\right)\]
\[k \approx 0.047\]
Kyun: \(e^{0} = 1\), is liye \(c\) seedha shuru wala mass hai. Phir 80 se divide kar ke \(\ln\) liya. \(\ln\frac{5}{8}\) negative hai (\(\approx -0.470\)), is liye aage wala minus \(k\) ko positive bana deta hai, jaisa decay constant ko hona chahiye.
Dhyan dein: agar aap ka \(k\) negative aa raha hai to kahin sign ki ghalti hai.

Qadam 3: (b) \(M(24)\) nikalein
\[M(t) = 80e^{-0.047t} \quad \ldots(2)\]
\[M(24) = 80e^{-0.047(24)}\]
\[= 80e^{-1.128}\]
\[\approx 25.8944 \approx 26 \text{ grams}\]
Kyun: \(c = 80\) aur \(k = 0.047\) ko (1) mein rakha, phir \(t = 24\). Calculator mein \(e^{-1.128} \approx 0.3237\) aata hai.

Qadam 4: (c) \(M = 20\) kab hoga
\[20 = 80e^{-0.047t}\]
\[e^{-0.047t} = \dfrac{1}{4}\]
\[0.047t = \ln 4\]
\[t = \dfrac{1.3863}{0.047}\]
\[t \approx 29.496\]
Kyun: is dafa waqt maloom karna hai, is liye \(t\) ko akela karna hai. Dono taraf \(\ln\) liya: \(\ln\frac{1}{4} = -\ln 4\), aur dono minus cancel ho gaye.

Tasdeeq:
Half-life \(= \frac{\ln 2}{k} = \frac{0.6931}{0.047} \approx 14.75\) ghante. 20 g, 80 g ka chautha hissa hai, yani do half-lives: \(2 \times 14.75 = 29.5\) ghante \(\checkmark\). Aur 24 ghante baad 26 g, 40 g (ek half-life) aur 20 g (do half-lives) ke darmiyan hai \(\checkmark\).
blocks.answer: (a) Decay constant \(k \approx 0.047\). (b) 24 ghante baad taqreeban 26 gram bachega. (c) Taqreeban 29.5 ghante baad sirf 20 gram bachega.

blocks.text: Deflation (qeematon ka girna)

Economics mein inflation ka matlab hai qeematein badh rahi hain aur deflation ka matlab hai qeematein gir rahi hain. Agar deflation 4% salana ho to qeemat har lamhe apni maujooda value ke 4% ki raftar se girti hai. Is liye yeh bhi decay model hai: \(\frac{dP}{dt} = -0.04P\).

blocks.title: Example 11
blocks.problem: (Deflation Problem in Economics) Suppose an economy is experiencing deflation at 4% per year. If the current price of an item is Rs. 500, find its expected price after 3 years.
steps:
Diya gaya: deflation 4% salana, \(P(0) = 500\) rupay; \(P\) waqt \(t\) saal par qeemat hai.
Maloom karna: \(P(3)\), yani 3 saal baad qeemat.
Tareeqa: qeemat girne ki raftar qeemat ke proportional hai, rate \(4\% = 0.04\): \(\frac{dP}{dt} = -0.04P\). Minus is liye ke qeemat kam ho rahi hai.

Qadam 1: Model aur us ka solution
\[\dfrac{dP}{dt} = -(4\%)P = -0.04P\]
\[\int\dfrac{dP}{P} = -0.04\int dt\]
\[P(t) = Ce^{-0.04t} \quad \ldots(1)\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya to \(\ln|P| = -0.04t + C_1\), phir dono taraf \(e\) liya aur \(C = e^{C_1}\) likha. Percentage ko hamesha decimal mein likhte hain: \(4\% = \frac{4}{100} = 0.04\).

Qadam 2: \(P(0) = 500\) lagayein
\[500 = Ce^{0} \Rightarrow C = 500\]
\[P(t) = 500e^{-0.04t}\]
Kyun: 'current price' ka matlab hai aaj ki qeemat, yani \(t = 0\) par qeemat.

Qadam 3: \(t = 3\) rakhein
\[P(3) = 500e^{-0.04(3)}\]
\[= 500e^{-0.12}\]
\[\approx 500(0.88692)\]
\[\approx 443.46\]
Kyun: 3 saal baad ki qeemat poochhi gayi hai; \(e^{-0.12} \approx 0.88692\).

Tasdeeq:
Mota andaza: har saal taqreeban 4% kam ho to \(500 \times 0.96^{3} \approx 442.4\). Hamara jawab 443.46 is ke bohat qareeb hai; continuous (har lamhe) deflation se thora sa farq aata hai \(\checkmark\).
blocks.answer: 3 saal baad item ki mutawaqqa (expected) qeemat taqreeban Rs. 443.5 hogi.

blocks.text: Cooling/Heating (thanda ya garam hona)

Garam chai kamre mein rakhein to shuru mein tezi se thandi hoti hai aur phir ahista ahista, kyunke jaise jaise us ka temperature kamre ke temperature ke qareeb aata hai, farq kam hota jata hai. Newton's law of cooling yahi kehta hai: thanda hone ki raftar farq \(T - T_S\) ke proportional hai, yani \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_S)\). Yahan \(T_S\) aas paas (surroundings) ka temperature hai.

blocks.title: Example 12
blocks.problem: (Cooling/Heating Problem) A cup of coffee is served at 90° C in a room where the temperature is 25° C. After 10 minutes, the coffee cools to 60° C. Find the temperature of the coffee after 20 minutes.
steps:
Diya gaya: kamre ka temperature \(T_S = 25\)°C, \(T(0) = 90\), \(T(10) = 60\); \(T\) waqt \(t\) minute par coffee ka temperature hai.
Maloom karna: \(T(20)\).
Tareeqa: Newton's law of cooling (Section 4.1.1 ka Example 2): \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - 25)\). Yeh separable hai.

Qadam 1: Variables alag karein aur integrate karein
\[\dfrac{1}{(T - 25)}\,dT = -k\,dt\]
\[\int\dfrac{dT}{T - 25} = -k\int dt\]
\[\ln|T - 25| = -kt + \ln|c|\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{T - 25}\) ka integral \(\ln|T - 25|\) hai. Constant ko \(\ln|c|\) ki shakal mein likha taa ke agla qadam saaf ho jaye; yeh sirf suhulat ke liye hai, koi naya rule nahi.

Qadam 2: Logarithm hatayein
\[\ln\left|\dfrac{T - 25}{c}\right| = -kt\]
\[\dfrac{T - 25}{c} = e^{-kt}\]
\[T(t) = 25 + ce^{-kt} \quad \ldots(1)\]
Kyun: \(\ln a - \ln b = \ln\frac{a}{b}\), phir dono taraf \(e\) liya, aur aakhir mein \(T\) ko akela kiya.

Qadam 3: \(T(0) = 90\) aur \(T(10) = 60\) lagayein
\[90 = 25 + c \Rightarrow c = 65\]
\[60 = 25 + 65e^{-10k}\]
\[e^{-10k} = \dfrac{35}{65} = \dfrac{7}{13}\]
\[e^{10k} = \dfrac{13}{7}\]
\[k = \tfrac{1}{10}\ln\tfrac{13}{7} \approx 0.0619\]
Kyun: \(c = 90 - 25\) shuru ka farq hai. Doosri condition se \(e^{-10k}\) mila; ulta (reciprocal) lene se \(e^{10k} = \frac{13}{7}\) aaya, phir \(\ln\) liya, to \(k\) positive aaya.
Dhyan dein: \(60 - 25 = 35\) hai, \(60\) nahi; farq hamesha kamre ke temperature se lete hain.

Tasdeeq:
\(k\) ko round kiye baghair: \(e^{-20k} = (e^{-10k})^{2} = \left(\frac{7}{13}\right)^{2}\), is liye
\[T(20) = 25 + 65 \cdot \dfrac{49}{169}\]
\[= 25 + \dfrac{245}{13} \approx 43.85 \;\checkmark\]
Jawab 25 (kamra) aur 60 (10 minute wali reading) ke darmiyan hai, jaisa hona chahiye.
blocks.answer: 20 minute baad coffee ka temperature taqreeban 43.85°C hoga.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal kitab ki nahi, hamari taraf se hai. Coffee ko 25°C tak pohanchne mein kitna waqt lagega? \(T = 25 + 65e^{-kt}\) mein \(e^{-kt}\) kabhi zero nahi hota, is liye \(T\) kabhi bilkul 25 nahi banta, sirf qareeb se qareeb tar hota jata hai.
Yani Newton's law ke mutabiq coffee kamre ke temperature ke qareeb to pohanchti hai magar theoretically kabhi bilkul barabar nahi hoti. Isi liye exam mein kabhi 'kamre ke temperature tak kab' wala sawal aaye to samajh lein ke data mein kuch kami hai.
RL Circuit (resistor aur inductor wala circuit)

Aakhri example electric circuit ka hai. Section 4.1.1 ke Example 4 (ii) mein humne dekha tha ke resistor \(R\) aur inductor \(L\) wale circuit mein Kirchhoff's voltage law se \(L\frac{dI}{dt} = V_S - RI\) banta hai. Inductor current ko achanak badhne nahi deta, is liye switch on karne par current zero se shuru ho kar ahista ahista ek fixed value tak jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 13
blocks.problem: (RL Circuit Problem) An RL circuit has an emf of 5 volts, a resistance 50 ohms, an inductor of 1 henry and no initial current. Find the current in the circuit at any time t.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(V_S = 5\) volts, \(R = 50\ \Omega\), \(L = 1\) henry aur \(I(0) = 0\).
Maloom karna: kisi bhi waqt \(t\) par circuit mein current \(I\).
Tareeqa: RL circuit ka model lagayenge jo separable hai; initial condition se constant aur sign dono tay honge.

Qadam 1: Differential equation (dekhiye Example 4, Section 4.1.1)
\[L\dfrac{dI}{dt} = V_S - RI \quad \because L = 1 \text{ henry}\]
\[\dfrac{dI}{dt} = 5 - 50I\]
Kyun: di gayi values \(L = 1\), \(V_S = 5\), \(R = 50\) rakhein.

Qadam 2: Variables alag karein aur integrate karein
\[5 - 50I = 5(1 - 10I)\]
\[\dfrac{1}{5}\int\dfrac{1}{1 - 10I}\,dI = \int dt\]
\[-\dfrac{1}{50}\int\dfrac{-10}{1 - 10I}\,dI = \int dt\]
\[-\dfrac{1}{50}\ln|1 - 10I| = t + C \quad \ldots(1)\]
Kyun: \(1 - 10I\) ka derivative \(-10\) hai. Agar numerator mein yahi derivative ho to \(\int\frac{f'}{f} = \ln|f|\) seedha lag jata hai. Is liye \(\frac{1}{5}\) ko \(-\frac{1}{50} \times (-10)\) likha: value wohi, magar ab \(-10\) upar aa gaya.
Dhyan dein: \(-\frac{1}{50}\) wala factor bhool jana sab se aam ghalti hai; \(\ln|1 - 10I|\) ka derivative \(\frac{-10}{1 - 10I}\) hai, sirf \(\frac{1}{1 - 10I}\) nahi.

Qadam 3: \(I(0) = 0\) lagayein
\[-\dfrac{1}{50}\ln|1 - 10(0)| = 0 + C\]
\[-\dfrac{1}{50}\ln|1| = C \Rightarrow C = 0\]
Kyun: \(\ln 1 = 0\). Shuru mein current zero tha, is liye constant bhi zero aaya.

Qadam 4: Current ke liye hal karein
\[-\dfrac{1}{50}\ln|1 - 10I| = t\]
\[\ln|1 - 10I| = -50t\]
\[|1 - 10I| = e^{-50t}\]
\[\pm(1 - 10I) = e^{-50t}\]
Kyun: \(-50\) se multiply kiya, phir dono taraf \(e\) liya. Modulus hatane par do signs aate hain, \(+\) aur \(-\).

Qadam 5: Initial condition se sahi sign chunein
\[\pm(1 - 10(0)) = e^{-50(0)} \Rightarrow \pm 1 = 1\]
\[1 - 10I = e^{-50t}\]
\[I(t) = \dfrac{1}{10}\left(1 - e^{-50t}\right)\]
Kyun: sirf \(+\) sign se \(1 = 1\) sahi banta hai, is liye negative sign chhor diya. Phir \(10I = 1 - e^{-50t}\) se \(I\) akela kiya.

Tasdeeq:
\(I(0) = \frac{1}{10}(1 - 1) = 0 \;\checkmark\). \(\frac{dI}{dt} = 5e^{-50t}\) aur \(5 - 50I = 5 - 5 + 5e^{-50t} = 5e^{-50t} \;\checkmark\). Jab \(t \to \infty\), \(I \to \frac{1}{10} = \frac{V_S}{R}\) A, jo Ohm's law wala steady current hai \(\checkmark\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab RL circuit ki equation ke liye 'Example 4, Section 4.1.2' ka hawala deti hai. Section 4.1.2 kitab mein maujood hi nahi; RL circuit ka model \(L\frac{dI}{dt} = V_S - RI\) Section 4.1.1 ke Example 4 (ii) mein banaya gaya hai. Hum ne upar sahi hawala, Section 4.1.1, likha hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar isi circuit mein resistance 50 ki jagah 100 ohm ho jaye to aakhir kaar (bohat der baad) current kitna hoga? Ishara: lambe waqt baad \(\frac{dI}{dt} = 0\), to \(V_S = RI\), yani \(I = \frac{5}{100} = 0.05\) A.

blocks.title: Half-Life
blocks.text: Half-life woh waqt hai jis mein kisi radioactive maadde ki miqdaar radioactive decay ki wajah se apni shuru wali miqdaar ki aadhi reh jati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh Half-Life box kitab mein Exercise 4.3 ke Question 4 ke saath chhapa hai. Decay model se is ka ek chhota sa formula nikalta hai, jo exercise mein bohat kaam aayega:
\[M_0 e^{-kT_{1/2}} = \tfrac{1}{2}M_0\]
\[kT_{1/2} = \ln 2\]
\[T_{1/2} = \dfrac{\ln 2}{k}, \quad k = \dfrac{\ln 2}{T_{1/2}}\]
Kyun: \(M_0\) dono taraf se cancel ho gaya, is liye half-life shuru wale mass par depend nahi karti: 160 gram ho ya 2 gram, aadha hone mein utna hi waqt lagta hai. \(n\) half-lives ke baad mass \(M_0\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n}\) reh jata hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal hamari taraf se hai. Agar bank 10% salana continuous munafa de to raqam kitne saal mein double hogi? Model \(\frac{dA}{dt} = 0.1A\), solution \(A = A_0e^{0.1t}\). Double ka matlab \(e^{0.1t} = 2\), yani
\[t = \dfrac{\ln 2}{0.1} \approx 6.93 \text{ saal}\]
Yeh half-life jaisa hi formula hai, bas growth ke liye: doubling time = ln 2 / rate.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
Growth: \(\frac{dN}{dt} = kN\) se \(N = N_0e^{kt}\). Decay: \(\frac{dM}{dt} = -kM\) se \(M = M_0e^{-kt}\) (\(k > 0\)).
Thanda ya garam hona: \(T = T_S + (T_0 - T_S)e^{-kt}\); \(T_S\) aas paas ka temperature hai.
RL circuit, \(I(0) = 0\): \(I = \frac{V_S}{R}\left(1 - e^{-Rt/L}\right)\); current zero se \(\frac{V_S}{R}\) ki taraf jata hai.
\(t = 0\) wali condition se constant of integration, doosri condition se \(k\).
Percentage rate ko decimal mein likhein: \(4\% = 0.04\).
Half-life: \(T_{1/2} = \frac{\ln 2}{k}\); har half-life mein miqdaar aadhi.
Har jawab ke saath unit likhein: gram, ghante, rupay, °C, amperes.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
Decay, deflation ya cooling mein minus sign bhool jana. Miqdaar kam ho rahi ho to \(\frac{dM}{dt} = -kM\) aur \(k > 0\).
Cooling mein \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -kT\) likh dena, jab ke sahi \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_S)\) hai; raftar kamre ke temperature se farq par depend karti hai.
4% ko 0.04 ki jagah 4 likh dena.
\(k\) ko bohat jaldi round kar dena. Jahan ho sake \(e^{-10k} = \frac{7}{13}\) jaisi fraction rakhein aur sirf aakhri jawab round karein.
Waqt ki units mila dena: agar \(k\) minute ke hisaab se nikala hai to \(t\) bhi minute mein rakhein, ghante mein nahi.
